COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Aug-10-2009 Judgment Entered
MINI MINUTES: This matter comes on calendar this day, having been assigned from the Presiding Judge Dept. 206 for Court Trial/Prove-Up Hearing. Comm: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, Reporter: Lois Jones, CSR #3689.

Elizabeth MacDonald, Esq. appeared for plaintiff FIA Card Services, N.A.
No appearance by defendant John A. Burgess.
Plaintiff's Trial Brief was filed today, August 10, 2009.
Declaration of Gary Springs in Lieu of Personal Testimony at Trial (CCP Section 98) was filed today, August 10, 2009.
Doe defendants were dismissed without prejudice today, August 10, 2009.
Notice of Time and Place of Trial was filed on April 29, 2009.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of plaintiff FIA Card Services, N.A., and against defendant John A. Burgess as follows:

Principal - $4,969.88.
Interest - $0.00.
Attorney's Fees - Reserved.
Costs - $230.00, for a total judgment in the amount of $5,199.88.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
